Synopsis:
    Russian FM Lavrov characterised Western accusations of Russian involvement in the Leipzig/Halle Airport drone incident as tantamount to a declaration of war, framing German Chancellor Merz's defence posture as an act of aggression. Germany had formally concluded on Sept 1 that Russia was responsible and retaliated diplomatically. Russia denied involvement and accused Berlin of fabricating evidence. The exchange marks a significant deterioration in Russia-Germany relations.
